name: CEPC Conceptual Design Report: Volume 1 - Accelerator

summary.plain: The first volume of the CEPC Conceptual Design Report, describing the accelerator complex and its civil engineering.
summary.technical: CEPC CDR vol. 1 (arXiv:1809.00285): the accelerator complex in a 100 km circumference underground tunnel, with space reserved for a later SPPC; the project is "initiated and hosted by China".
